_source: nc_agrade_finish.mp4 (bucket: source/nc_agrade_finish.mp4; 1280x720, 29.989 fps CFR, 281 frames, 9.45 s)
_notes: Source frames 180-250, line-anchored stabilisation (the pan is 4-10 px/frame here). Coordinates are output pixels; frame 0 = source 180.
Camera is past the line on the right kerb, looking up the road: riders come head-on and move down and left across the line in the image.
finishLine is the painted yellow span only (x 330-850). Riders who cross on the unpainted extension left of the white edge line (by the official) are NOT labelled.
Crossings: first frame the front tyre's contact point is on the line, by eye on 2-3x zooms, +-1 frame. Riders are 0.2-0.5 s apart, no bunch, so each has its own group.
Source frames 251-280 are not usable: fast pan back plus tilt and roll; the line tracker loses the line.
